Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Spotify on any device.** Under **Music → Player**, pick **Spotify Web** to follow your Spotify account directly, so the lyrics work even when the music plays on your phone, a speaker or another computer. Spotify needs you to make a free app once: the **Spotify account** card walks you through it (open the dashboard, create an app with the Redirect URI shown, paste its Client ID, then sign in). Needs Spotify Premium. Your sign-in stays on your computer and is only readable by you.
- **Lyrics on the title screen.** The song's lines now play under the buttons of the main menu. Turn them off with **Display → Main menu → Lyrics on the title screen**.

### Better

- **Follow is instant.** Lyrics in the sky now stay right where you look, with no catch-up delay. If you liked the old slow glide, turn on **Lyrics → Lazy follow**.
